description:
Cast Exalted Sunborn for its warp cost by paying {1}{W} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Exalted Sunborn enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating two token copies of it that are 1/1.
Cast Disruptor of Currents by paying at most {U}{U} and tapping the three Exalted Sunborns, plus an additional {2} at most for its offspring cost.
When Disruptor of Currents enters, its innate ability and offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating eight token copies of it that are 1/1 due to the Exalted Sunborns.
When the Disruptor of Currents tokens enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning the nontoken Disruptor of Currents from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Cast Disruptor of Currents by tapping five Disruptor of Currents tokens and tapping an additional two Disruptor of Currents tokens to pay its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 4.
